_comment: Question templates for the mock interview. {skill} is replaced by the required skill. 'keywords' are the terms a good answer is expected to touch; the rule-based scorer counts them.

intro.text: Tell me briefly about your background and why you are interested in the {title} role at {company}.

language.text: Describe a project where you used {skill} seriously. What was hard about it and how did you structure the code?
How do you make {skill} code easy for a colleague to read and maintain?

embedded.text: Walk me through how you would bring up and debug a new sensor over {skill}. What tools do you reach for first?
What goes wrong with {skill} in practice, and how do you design firmware so those failures are safe?

iot.text: Explain how you would get sensor data from a device to the cloud using {skill}. What happens when the network drops?
How would you secure a fleet of devices that use {skill}? What must never be stored in the firmware?

data.text: Tell me about a time you used {skill} on messy real data. How did you validate that your results were right?
How do you decide whether a model built with {skill} is actually good enough to use?

cloud.text: Describe a system you ran on {skill}. How did you keep it reliable and how did you know when it broke?
How do you keep costs and permissions under control when working with {skill}?

web.text: How would you design and test an API with {skill}? What makes an API easy to consume?

mobile.text: Tell me about an app you built with {skill}. How did it behave offline and how did you test it?

control.text: Explain how you would tune a controller using {skill} for a slow thermal process. What are the risks of overshoot?

process.text: How do you use {skill} in your day-to-day work, and what difference has it made?

mqtt.text: In MQTT, what do QoS levels, retained messages and the last-will message give you, and when would you use each?

freertos.text: In a FreeRTOS firmware with several tasks sharing sensor state, how do you avoid races and priority problems?

pid control.text: Explain the three terms of a PID controller and what anti-windup protects against.

sql.text: How would you find the ten customers with the fastest-growing monthly spend using SQL?

docker.text: What problem does Docker solve for a small team, and what should never go into an image?

scikit-learn.text: Describe how you would set up a scikit-learn pipeline with cross-validation so there is no data leakage.

esp32.text: Compare the ESP32's Wi-Fi, deep sleep and dual-core features and how they affect a battery-powered sensor node.

aws.text: You have a telemetry stream from a thousand devices. Which AWS services would you choose and why?

gap.text: The posting asks for {skill}, which I do not see on your CV. How would you close that gap in the first three months?

behavioural.text: Tell me about a time something you built failed in use. What did you change afterwards?
Describe a disagreement with a teammate about a technical decision and how it was resolved.
